title: What Geothermal District Heating 2.0 Is
definition: Geothermal District Heating 2.0: next-gen geothermal for districts.
description:
Geothermal District Heating 2.0 is next-gen geothermal for districts. It sits squarely in Future Energy Systems, the frontier where heat networks science becomes heating logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are retrofits-scale. Societies that master heating hulls early will shape drilling practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why heat networks programs worldwide now treat Geothermal District Heating 2.0 as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Geothermal District Heating 2.0 needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Geothermal District Heating 2.0
title: Real Research Today: Geothermal District Heating 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind Geothermal District Heating 2.0.
description:
The road to Geothermal District Heating 2.0 is already being paved. Small modular reactor designs (NuScale, Rolls-Royce SMR) move through licensing worldwide. The US National Ignition Facility achieved fusion ignition (net energy gain) in December 2022.

Long-duration storage (iron-air batteries, Form Energy) targets 100-hour grid backup. Together these programs form the heat networks foundation that Geothermal District Heating 2.0 will build on — the heating logistics results, the drilling methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as heating logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Geothermal District Heating 2.0 Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Geothermal District Heating 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Geothermal District Heating 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 71607 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where heat networks monitoring, heating logistics redundancy, or drilling maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Geothermal District Heating 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Geothermal District Heating 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Geothermal District Heating 2.0 — next-gen geothermal for districts.

Phase 1 — Prove (heat networks): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (heating logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (drilling): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (retrofits): heating hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cities-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
